channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Is Israel following international law in Iran? Interview with Benny Gantz
item.description: We spoke to the Chairman of the Israeli opposition Blue & White Party and the former defence minister Benny Gantz.

item.title: Fire wipes out historic Glasgow building and closes train station
item.description: Scotland's busiest train station, Glasgow Central, is to remain closed for the rest of today and tomorrow after a fire tore through a neighbouring building.

item.title: Oil prices surge as Israel-US war triggers global crisis
item.description: Oil markets have been in turmoil Monday, nearly touching $120 a barrel at one point.

item.title: Iran war is worst possible news for the cost of living in UK
item.description: As the impact of the war on Iran spreads across the world, it is having a political impact in the UK.

item.title: Will Trump face any backlash in US over spiralling cost of war in Iran?
item.description: Donald Trump is speaking to Republican Party members Monday evening for the first time since he started the war on Iran.

item.title: Markets can’t contain months of war – former World Trade Organisation chief
item.description: We were joined by French political consultant and businessman Pascal Lamy, who was also the head of the World Trade Organisation.

item.title: Andy Burnham: Duchy of Lancaster response to illegal Wigan waste dump ‘not acceptable’
item.description: The Manchester mayor Andy Burnham has condemned the Duchy of Lancaster, the private estate of King Charles, for what he said is its failure to support the cleanup of a giant illegal waste dump near Wigan.

item.title: Backlash and celebration in Iran over new Supreme Leader
item.description: The announcement Sunday night that Iran's new leader will be Mojtaba Khamenei brought the regime's supporters on to the streets of Tehran in celebration.

item.title: Israel blows up Beirut financial firm it claims supports Hezbollah
item.description: Israel has targeted financial institutions in southern Beirut that it says have helped to provide backing for Hezbollah.

item.title: Inside secret Iraqi Kurdistan base with fighters ready to attack Iran
item.description: Last week, Donald Trump said that Kurdish fighters could mount a ground incursion into Iran.
